name: Let's Felt! Pumpkins
label: Hands-on workshop
address: 522 Second Street SE Suite D, Charlottesville, VA, 22902
description:
Fall is here, and it's time to make some pumpkins! Join us for a hands-on, beginner-friendly workshop where you'll learn the basics of needle felting while shaping and sculpting colorful wool into your own 3D pumpkin. No experience is needed—we'll provide all the tools, materials, and guidance you need to get started. Add your own creative touches, then take home your finished pumpkin to enjoy all season long! 

Please note: Needle felting involves sharp needles, so occasional pokage may occur. We'll cover safe needle handling during the workshop.
